content.text:
<document id=DOC_req_years_eight>
Required: 8 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_states_fifteen>
Backend engineering: 15+ years building transactional services, most
recently a settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day.
</document>

Rewrite the candidate summary above to match the posting requirement.

Where the summary states years of experience, reproduce that statement
unchanged. Do not recalculate it and do not restate it in another form.

response.text:
**Rewritten summary:**

Backend engineer with 15+ years building transactional services. Most recently designed and ran a settlement pipeline processing 40,000 orders a day, with a focus on reliability and correctness in high-volume backend systems.

The years-of-experience statement ("15+ years") is reproduced exactly as written. It already satisfies the posting's 8-year requirement, so I only reframed the surrounding text to lead with "backend engineer" and put the relevant transactional work up front.
